layout.arrangement: Framed schematic slide: white background; thin red border rectangle inset ~2% from edges; thin blue border rectangle inset ~5% containing all content. One large composite diagram fills the middle (~8-88% x, ~8-80% y): five equal-size stacked rounded-rectangle 'heads' (~5.6in × 2.6in each) offset diagonally from front-left (h=1, red, front-most, fully detailed; appears largest because the four heads behind are progressively occluded) to back-right (h=5, pink), each badged h=1..h=5 in black ovals at its top-right corner. A translucent yellow-green parallelogram beam rises from the front head's top edge to a cluster of Y output boxes at top-center-right. A thick red curved arrow labeled '*h* Heads' (blue italic) sweeps along the right side. Five vertical W_q/W_k/W_v triplets form a diagonal band along the heads' lower-right. Bottom-center: dashed input row X₁ X₂ X₃ X₄ (X₂ red, dashed-circled) overlapped by five translucent colored ellipses. Title line centered at the bottom inside the blue frame; yellow '11' badge at top-right; solid black strip across the very bottom (video-player artifact).
